title: Advanced Cloud Engineer roadmap
summary: A focused plan to deepen expertise, build a senior-level portfolio, and prepare for leadership roles and interviews. It blends advanced cloud concepts, real-world projects, and job-ready polish.

phases.title: Foundations refresh
phases.summary: Reinforce core cloud concepts and security fundamentals.

milestones.title: Cloud fundamentals review
milestones.outcome: Explain core services and deployment models across AWS, GCP, and Azure.

tasks.title: Read AWS global infrastructure overview
tasks.description: Study the official AWS documentation on regions, availability zones, and edge locations.

tasks.title: Watch GCP architecture overview video
tasks.description: View the free YouTube series from Google Cloud that outlines core services.

tasks.title: Compare Azure Service categories chart
tasks.description: Create a side-by-side table of compute, storage, networking, and security services for Azure.

tasks.title: Summarize key differences in a one-page doc
tasks.description: Write a concise comparison that you can reference in interviews.

milestones.title: IAM & security foundations
milestones.outcome: Design secure identity and access controls for multi-cloud environments.

tasks.title: Complete freeCodeCamp IAM module
tasks.description: Finish the IAM lessons covering users, groups, roles, and policies.

tasks.title: Build a cross-account role in AWS
tasks.description: Create a role that allows read-only access from a second AWS account.

tasks.title: Configure GCP Service account least-privilege
tasks.description: Set up a service account with only the permissions needed for a Cloud Function.

tasks.title: Document security best-practice checklist
tasks.description: Write a checklist you can use for future projects and client reviews.

phases.title: Core skills expansion
phases.summary: Develop deeper networking, compute, storage, and cost-management abilities.

milestones.title: Advanced networking
milestones.outcome: Architect VPCs, subnets, and hybrid connectivity with optimal performance.

tasks.title: Read AWS VPC design guide
tasks.description: Study the official guide focusing on CIDR planning and peering.

tasks.title: Build a multi-zone VPC with NAT
tasks.description: Create a VPC spanning two AZs, add public/private subnets, and configure a NAT gateway.

tasks.title: Set up GCP Cloud VPN tunnel
tasks.description: Connect a GCP VPC to an on-prem network using the free Cloud VPN tutorial.

tasks.title: Sketch network diagram in Lucidchart
tasks.description: Produce a clear diagram of the architecture you built for reference.

milestones.title: Compute and storage
milestones.outcome: Select and configure optimal compute and storage services for varied workloads.

tasks.title: Watch Azure compute services overview
tasks.description: View the Microsoft Learn module covering VMs, App Service, and Functions.

tasks.title: Deploy a containerized app on GKE
tasks.description: Use a free tutorial to run a Docker image on Google Kubernetes Engine.

tasks.title: Configure Azure blob lifecycle policy
tasks.description: Set up rules that move old data to cool storage automatically.

tasks.title: Write a decision matrix for service selection
tasks.description: Compare compute/storage options across providers for a sample workload.

milestones.title: Cost management techniques
milestones.outcome: Implement monitoring and optimization strategies to reduce cloud spend.

tasks.title: Read AWS Cost Explorer documentation
tasks.description: Study the official docs on usage reports, budgets, and alerts.

tasks.title: Create a cost-allocation tag strategy
tasks.description: Define a tagging scheme and apply it to resources in a sandbox account.

tasks.title: Run a cost-optimization simulation on GCP
tasks.description: Use the free GCP Pricing Calculator to model different instance types.

tasks.title: Summarize findings in a cost-savings report
tasks.description: Draft a one-page report with actionable recommendations.

phases.title: Proof of work
phases.summary: Build portfolio projects that showcase senior-level cloud design.

milestones.title: 3-Tier scalable application
milestones.outcome: Demonstrate end-to-end design, CI/CD, and monitoring for a production-grade app.

tasks.title: Design architecture diagram
tasks.description: Sketch a 3-tier web, app, and database layout using any cloud provider.

tasks.title: Implement infrastructure as code
tasks.description: Use Terraform (free tutorials) to provision all resources automatically.

tasks.title: Set up CI/CD pipeline
tasks.description: Configure GitHub Actions to build, test, and deploy the app on each push.

tasks.title: Add CloudWatch/Stackdriver monitoring
tasks.description: Create dashboards and alerts for latency and error rates.

tasks.title: Write project README and blog post
tasks.description: Document the design decisions, challenges, and outcomes for public sharing.

milestones.title: Cost-Optimised architecture write-up
milestones.outcome: Show ability to audit, redesign, and document cost-saving measures.

tasks.title: Select an existing cloud workload
tasks.description: Choose a personal or open-source project with measurable spend.

tasks.title: Analyze cost reports with native tools
tasks.description: Export billing data from AWS Cost Explorer or GCP Billing Export.

tasks.title: Redesign using spot/preemptible instances
tasks.description: Modify the architecture to replace on-demand VMs with cheaper alternatives.

tasks.title: Calculate projected savings
tasks.description: Quantify the cost reduction and present it in a table.

tasks.title: Publish the write-up on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Share the findings as a professional article to attract recruiters.

phases.title: Getting ready
phases.summary: Polish certifications, leadership skills, and interview readiness for senior roles.

milestones.title: Associate-level certification prep
milestones.outcome: Pass an AWS, GCP, or Azure associate exam with confidence.

tasks.title: Enroll in free exam prep on AWS training
tasks.description: Complete the free associate-level learning path on the AWS website.

tasks.title: Take practice exam on Whizlabs (free version)
tasks.description: Attempt a timed practice test and note weak areas.

tasks.title: Review exam guide and create flashcards
tasks.description: Summarize each domain on flashcards for quick recall.

tasks.title: Schedule a mock interview with a peer
tasks.description: Run through scenario questions focusing on design and trade-offs.

tasks.title: Reflect on feedback and update study plan
tasks.description: Incorporate reviewer comments into a revised learning schedule.

milestones.title: Leadership & architecture vision
milestones.outcome: Lead technical discussions and produce strategic cloud roadmaps.

tasks.title: Read "The Phoenix project" summary
tasks.description: Absorb key DevOps and leadership principles from the free summary article.

tasks.title: Facilitate a design review session
tasks.description: Lead a mock architecture review with colleagues using your portfolio project.

tasks.title: Create a 3-year cloud strategy document
tasks.description: Outline migration, modernization, and cost-optimization goals for a fictional enterprise.

tasks.title: Present strategy to a mentor
tasks.description: Deliver a 15-minute presentation and gather constructive feedback.

tasks.title: Document lessons learned
tasks.description: Write a brief reflection on leadership challenges and next steps.

milestones.title: Senior interview preparation
milestones.outcome: Confidently answer system-design, troubleshooting, and behavioral questions.

tasks.title: Study system design primer on GitHub
tasks.description: Read the free repository covering scalability, caching, and data partitioning.

tasks.title: Practice whiteboard design for a CDN
tasks.description: Sketch a content-delivery network architecture and explain choices aloud.

tasks.title: Solve 5 troubleshooting scenarios on LeetCode (cloud tag)
tasks.description: Work through real-world incident cases to sharpen diagnostic skills.

tasks.title: Record answers to behavioral questions
tasks.description: Film yourself answering common STAR questions and review for improvement.

tasks.title: Network with senior cloud engineers on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Send personalized connection requests and request brief informational chats.
